title: update --dry-run writes nothing, update writes only what SWERepo wrote, and a second update writes nothing
assertion: In a repository with files of the person's own (CLAUDE.md with CRLF line endings, README.md, a hand-made `.github/swerepo/ruleset.json`), set up by `swerepo init`, with a line of the person's after SWERepo's block in AGENTS.md, and whose AGENTS.md block was written by an older template so there is an update to apply: `swerepo update --dry-run` exits 0, names the update, and leaves every file unchanged (none added or removed; modification times, sizes and bytes, `.git` included). `swerepo update --yes` changes AGENTS.md, whose SWERepo block becomes exactly the new template's render while the text before and after the block (the person's line after it included) stays as it was, and changes, adds or removes nothing else but `.swerepo.toml`; the person's files are byte for byte as `init` left them. A second `swerepo update --yes` says "Nothing to do." and leaves every file unchanged.

origin.text: ADR-20261124-7afa (Phase 6): update builds on init's plan, so it keeps init's promises (inv_1002d669, inv_8314036c): a dry run writes nothing, only what SWERepo wrote is updated, files SWERepo didn't write are never touched, and a second run has nothing to do. Tightened after SeamSpec's reviewer and the owner (2026-11-24): AGENTS.md must actually get the new render, deletions count as changes, and the text around the block stays, a line of the person's after it included.

status_reason: Phase 8 adds agents/block@3 (the spec rule, ADR-20261124-4d76). The locked test names agents/block@2 as the version update moves an @1 block to, so it fails now that @3 is the latest, although update behaves exactly as the rule says. The replacement inv_4a53ca43 has the same title and the same assertion word for word; its test takes the latest agents/block version from the template store (and asserts it isn't @1) instead of naming @2, so later block versions don't break it either. Planned in Gemini's design review (P8-D02), and the owner agreed on 2026-11-24. Checked: with block/3.md removed both tests pass; with it, only the replacement does.
